description: This file defines a React functional component 'SkillDistributionRing' that renders an interactive skill distribution ring chart for a learner dashboard. It manages state for skills, proficiency levels, and user interactions such as adding, modifying, or deleting skills. It also fetches data from an API and updates the learner's profile accordingly.

methods.name: handleAddSkill
methods.description: Handles adding a new skill to the user's profile; updates profile via API and refreshes data.

methods.name: handleModifySkill
methods.description: Handles modifying an existing skill's proficiency; updates profile via API and refreshes data.

methods.name: handleRemoveSkill
methods.description: Handles removing a skill from the user's profile; updates profile via API and refreshes data.
